decision_record.question: Is this template used by a rule (assignment, auto-response, escalation) or by Flow?
decision_record.answer: By neither: by an approval process (its emailTemplate element) for the submit email, and by two WorkflowAlerts for the approve and reject emails. All three consumers are metadata-deployed, none is Flow.

decision_record.question: Which record is the merge context: Case, Lead, Contact?
decision_record.source: decision D4 (approval on the Opportunity) + upstream artefacts (M1-S01's two Opportunity fields) + requirement.md items 2 and 3
decision_record.determined: Every merge field is {!Opportunity.<field>} with no parent traversal: Name, StageName, CloseDate, Amount, Discount__c, Approval_Status__c.

decision_record.question: Which actions fire on submit, approve, reject, and recall - and do those objects exist in the target org?
decision_record.answer: Q33 verbatim: submit = email to the manager + Approval_Status__c Pending + lock; approve = email to the rep + Approved + unlock; reject = email to the rep with the comments + Rejected + unlock; recall = field cleared + unlock + no email.
decision_record.determined: Exactly three templates, not four. The submit email is the approval process's own emailTemplate (no alert), and recall sends nothing. The 'with the comments' clause is delivered through Approval History per assumption A27.

decision_record.question: Could the same event fire twice?
decision_record.answer: No. Q33's four events are distinct approval outcomes, and no two of them send the same template.
decision_record.determined: One template per sending event, and no alert on the submit event - an alert there would send the manager a second copy of the approval request.

decision_record.answer: No. These are internal emails between a rep and their manager on an Opportunity; requirement.md item 6 puts integrations and data migration out of scope, and no Email-to-Case exists in this build.
